cards.text: used to + kata kerja dasar: kebiasaan atau keadaan di masa lalu yang sekarang sudah tidak lagi.

examples.en: I used to play badminton every week.
examples.id: Dulu saya main bulu tangkis setiap minggu.

examples.en: This shop used to be a cinema.

cards.text: used to hanya untuk masa lalu. Tidak ada bentuk sekarang I use to. Untuk sekarang, pakai present simple.

examples.en: We used to live in a village, but now we live in a city.
examples.id: Dulu kami tinggal di desa, sekarang di kota.

cards.trap: Bahasa Indonesia memakai "dulu". Dalam bahasa Inggris, "dulu" + kebiasaan = used to.

cards.text: Kalimat tanya: Did you use to ...? Negatif: didn't use to ... (atau used not to ...).

examples.en: Did you use to walk to school?
examples.id: Dulu kamu berjalan kaki ke sekolah?

examples.en: I didn't use to like coffee.

cards.trap: Jangan tertukar dengan be used to + -ing (sudah terbiasa), yang dibahas di Unit 61.

questions.prompt: I ___ to drink a lot of soda, but now I drink water.
questions.why: Kebiasaan di masa lalu yang sudah berhenti: used to + kata kerja dasar.
Pertanyaan used to memakai Did + subjek + use to.

questions.prompt: My brother use to play football, but he stopped.
questions.answer: My brother used to play football, but he stopped.
questions.why: Untuk kebiasaan masa lalu, bentuknya used to, bukan use to.

questions.prompt: There ___ (used to / be) a big tree in front of our house.
questions.why: Keadaan di masa lalu yang sudah tidak ada: used to be.

questions.prompt: Susun kalimat: "Dulu saya tidak suka sayur."
questions.answer: I didn't use to like vegetables.
questions.why: Negatif used to: didn't use to + kata kerja dasar.

questions.answer: He used to live in Bandung
accept: She used to live in Bandung
questions.why: "Dulu" + keadaan yang sudah berakhir = used to + kata kerja dasar.

pairs: watch cartoons every morning as a kid.
questions.why: used to + kata kerja dasar = kebiasaan dulu; was -ing = sedang berlangsung; be used to + -ing = sudah terbiasa (Unit 61).

questions.prompt: We ___ (not / use to) have a car, but now we have two.
questions.why: Negatif used to: didn't use to. Bentuk used not to juga benar.

questions.prompt: I ___ watch a lot of TV, but now I prefer reading.
questions.why: Kebiasaan di masa lalu yang sudah berubah: used to + kata kerja dasar.

questions.prompt: Did you use to live near the sea?
questions.answer: Did you use to live near the sea?
questions.why: Kalimat ini sudah benar: setelah did, bentuknya use to (tanpa d).
